attributes.name: Khabekh-Shu
attributes.powers:
Before you act, each character at your location must succeed at a Dexterity or Acrobatics 6 check. Each character that fails is dealt 1d4 Electricity damage.

After you act, each character at this location is dealt 1 Acid damage.

If Khabekh-Shu would be defeated, search the location deck he came from for the henchman Sand Kraken. If you do not find it, Khabekh-Shu is undefeated.
